sources.title: OPC Unified Architecture Part 4: Services — Subscription/Publish
sources.supports: NotificationMessage 32位1起循环、keep-alive不含Notifications、Publish ACK、availableSequenceNumbers无重传支持可为空
sources.limits: 官网网页未显示明确版本发布日期；不是具体OEM能力证明，不能将ACK视为D17持久化证明

sources.title: OPC UA Part 4: Services — Republish and reconnect
sources.supports: Republish失败Bad_MessageNotAvailable、失联后Session再激活/转移/重建、缺口需ResendData或Read最新值但不重构历史
sources.limits: 恢复最后值不能冒充缺失历史观测；具体保留窗口和真实运行未核

sources.title: OPC UA Part 4: Services — TransferSubscriptions
sources.supports: TransferSubscriptions跨Session有服务确认，失败须新建Subscription；旧会话不可由本地猜测继续提交
sources.limits: Procet Owner CAS/取消Fence为内部设计，非OPC规范逐字要求
